theorem mvcc.api.mvccReaderN_eq : mvcc.api.mvccReaderN = backend.rdStockN

def mvcc.api.etcdStorage_open.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (bk : mvcc.KBReal) (Pk K : backend.BNames → IProp GF) (D : backend.Data) (L : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) (u : Bool),
    mvcc.bridgeParams bk.P →
      bk.cm = true →
        ⊢
          ((□ ∀ γ b', mvcc.keySized γ bk.P b') ∗
              mvcc.api.mvccImage D L c u ∗
                backend.newPostKP bk.γB bk.P (fun x => mvcc.api.mvccW bk.gx) Pk K bk.be D ∗
                  mvcc.api.mvccWReg bk.gx ∗
                    backend.wbTok bk.γB ∗
                      backend.wbTok bk.γB ∗
                        □ (⧗1 ={⊤}=∗ backend.wbTok bk.γB) ∗
                          [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate backend.rdStockN (), backend.bOpen bk.γB backend.rdOpen) ={⊤}=∗
            mvcc.api.mvccStorageFor (mvcc.api.etcdStorage bk) (Pk bk.γB) L c u ∗ mvcc.api.backendRest bk.γB bk.P K bk.be D

theorem mvcc.api.etcdStorage_rest (bk : mvcc.KBReal) : mvcc.api.storageRest (mvcc.api.etcdStorage
    bk) = [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate backend.rdStockN (), backend.bOpen bk.γB backend.rdOpen

theorem mvcc.api.etcdStorage_inj {bk bk' : mvcc.KBReal} (h : mvcc.api.etcdStorage bk =
    mvcc.api.etcdStorage bk') : bk = bk'

theorem mvcc.api.etcdStorage_req (bk : mvcc.KBReal) (Pk X Y : IProp GF) : mvcc.api.storageReq
    (mvcc.api.etcdStorage bk) Pk X Y = backend.commitReq bk.γB bk.P Pk bk.be X Y

def mvcc.api.mvccImage_snapshot.law : Prop :=
  backend.backend.Snapshot.spec →
    ∀ (kv : GoInterface) (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (bk : mvcc.KBReal) (Pk : IProp GF) (qo : Qp) (R : IProp GF)
      (Q : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString → GMap GoString backend.BktData → Prop)
      (Φ : mvcc.api.MvccState → IProp GF),
      ⊢
        ∀ Φ_1,
          isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend ∗
              mvcc.api.isMvcc kv γ ∗
                mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ 1 (mvcc.api.etcdStorage bk) Pk ∗
                  backend.bOpen bk.γB qo ∗
                    backend.wbTok bk.γB ∗
                      R ∗
                        (□ ∀ d r, R -∗ Pk -∗ backend.hkOwn bk.γB d -∗ backend.rbOwn bk.γB r -∗ ⌜Q d r⌝) ∗
                          AU <{ ∃∃ σ, mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ ∗ ⌜σ.pending = none⌝ }> @ ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.api.mvccN, ∅ <{
                              mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ, COMM Φ σ }> -∗
            (▷
                ∀ sp D,
                  (backend.snapOpen sp D ∗
                      backend.bOpen bk.γB qo ∗
                        R ∗
                          mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ 1 (mvcc.api.etcdStorage bk) Pk ∗
                            ⌜Q (backend.hkData bk.P D) (backend.rbData bk.P D)⌝ ∗
                              ∃ σ u, Φ σ ∗ mvcc.api.mvccImage D σ.log σ.crev u) -∗
                    Φ_1
                      (intoVal
                        (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.snapshot.ty.PointerType
                          (intoVal sp)))) -∗
              WP
                ((intoVal
                    (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.backend.ty.PointerType
                      go!"Snapshot" (intoVal bk.be)))
                  (intoVal ()))
                {{ Φ_1 }}

def mvcc.api.mvccBackend_isBackend.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (q : Qp) (bk : mvcc.KBReal) (Pk : IProp GF),
    mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q (mvcc.api.etcdStorage bk) Pk ⊢ □ backend.isBackend bk.γB bk.P (mvcc.api.mvccW bk.gx) Pk bk.be

def (sealed) mvcc.api.etcdStorage (bk : mvcc.KBReal) : mvcc.api.MvccStorage

def mvcc.api.backendRest_open.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (γB : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (K : backend.BNames → IProp GF) (b : Loc) (D : backend.Data),
    mvcc.api.backendRest γB P K b D ⊢
      backend.isStopChans γB b ∗
        K γB ∗ backend.plHook γB func.nil ∗ backend.rbOwn γB (backend.rbData P D) ∗ backend.rdPool γB P b

def mvcc.api.mvccImage_fresh.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (D : backend.Data),
    (∀ (k : GoString), backend.dget D mvcc.keyName k = none) →
      backend.dget D go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.metaName mvcc.schedKeyBytes = none →
        backend.dget D go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.metaName mvcc.finKeyBytes = none →
          ⊢ |==> mvcc.api.mvccImage D mvcc.api.mvccStart.log mvcc.api.mvccStart.crev false
